source: Fleeting weekly discovery crawl, whole board (scripts/out/<date>/board.json, board_source.py rule)
methodology: Each row is a distinct time-limited Nashville window that is open as of the as_of timestamp and carries a real, parseable closing date. Windows the crawl could not verify, windows with no datable close, and windows that have already closed are excluded -- no date is ever invented. 'closes' is the last day to catch a run or the date of a one-off; 'days_left' is counted from the build date.
